content: {DRAFT} When Eth_Transmit() is called, the given BuffIdx pointer shall be assigned to the SW FIFO with the EthCtrlConfigEgressFifoPriorityAssignment matches the priority given previously by the pr evious Eth_ProvideTxBuffer() call (see SWS_Eth_00267 ).

When Eth_Transmit() is called and EthCrtlConfigSwBufferHan- dling is set to TRUE, the given BuffIdx pointer shall be assigned to the SW FIFO with the EthCtrlConfigEgressFifoPriorityAssignment which matches the priority given pre- viously by the previous Eth_ProvideTxBuffer() call (see [SWS_Eth_00267]).

{OBSOLETE} When Eth_Transmit() is called and EthCrtlCon- figSwBufferHandling is set to TRUE, the given BuffIdx pointer shall be as- signed to the SW FIFO with the EthCtrlConfigEgressFifoPriorityAssignment which matches the priority given previously by the previous Eth_ProvideTxBuffer() call (see [SWS_Eth_00267]).
